about: Role → skill registry (docs/adr/0014-role-skills.md). Validated at load by src/skills/registry.ts; the README table between the skills-registry markers is generated from it (src/skills/readme.ts). A skill is only guidance: Kitchen copies its SKILL.md text into the role's prompt, pinned by sha256 in the ledger.

anthropic.claude: put the {name} skill folder (with its SKILL.md) in ~/.claude/skills/{name}/ or <repo>/.claude/skills/{name}/
anthropic.codex: put the {name} skill folder (with its SKILL.md) in ~/.agents/skills/{name}/ or <repo>/.agents/skills/{name}/

local.about: used when present; nothing installs it
local.claude: put the {name} skill folder (with its SKILL.md) in ~/.claude/skills/{name}/ or <repo>/.claude/skills/{name}/
local.codex: put the {name} skill folder (with its SKILL.md) in ~/.agents/skills/{name}/ or <repo>/.agents/skills/{name}/

reviewer-ui.fallback: the reviewer-ui.md rubric; the Report says degraded

verifier.fallback: none: the verifier judges only what needs eyes
